item.title: Thunderstorm Advisory No. 10 #MINPRSD
item.description:
Thunderstorm Advisory No. 10 #MINPRSD
Issued at 09:00 AM 18 August 2026

Moderate to occasionally heavy rainshowers with lightning and strong winds are expected over #LanaoDelSur(Malabang, Calanogas, Pualas, Madamba), #LanaoDelNorte(Salvador, Baroy, Tubod), #ZamboangaSibugay(Kabasalan), #ZamboangaDelNorte(Sindangan, Godod, LeonB.Postigo, Siayan, Salug), #ZamboangaDelSur(Midsalip, Sominot, RamonMagsaysay, Tambulig, Dumingag, Mahayag, Molave, Josefina), #MisamisOccidental(Bonifacio, TangubCity, OzamisCity and DonVictorianoChiongbian) within the next 1-2 hours.

The above conditions are being experienced in #LanaoDelNorte(SultanNagaDimaporo, Kapatagan, Sapad, Nunungan, Lala), #LanaoDelSur(Picong), #ZamboangaDelSur(Dinas, Margosatubig, VincenzoA.Sagun, Dimataling, Pitogo, Tabina, SanPablo, PagadianCity, Dumalinao, Guipos, SanMiguel, Lapuyan, Tigbao, Lakewood, Bayog, Kumalarang, Labangan, Tukuran, Aurora), #ZamboangaSibugay(Alicia, Payao, Malangas, Mabuhay, Talusan, Olutanga, Siay, Diplahan, Buug and Imelda) which may persist within 1-2 hours and may affect nearby areas.

All are advised to take precautionary measures against the impacts associated with these hazards which include flash floods and landslides.

Keep monitoring for updates.
